author: EmuCore - Hub
title: shadPS4 0.17.0: official development build
summary: shadPS4 published 0.17.0 on July 30, 2026. The release record documents an official development build for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.17.0 on July 30, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: ShadNet, our own networking backend, is now integrated for the first time. Most of the matchmaking library is implemented — lobbies, rooms, joining, signaling. Friends support. Make your online friends in shadnet. Invitation dialog.
